md.p1: Mr. Hasil Navliwala is a visionary Managing Director with expertise in pharmaceutical quality assurance, known for his strong leadership, strategic mindset, and focus on quality systems and regulatory compliance. With a background in M.Pharm (Quality Assurance), he brings a detail-oriented and results-driven approach to ensuring consistent product quality and adherence to global standards. Carrying forward the legacy of his grandfather, Mr. Karim Navliwala, he is committed to upholding the values of integrity, quality, and trust. His dedication to excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement drives organizational growth and operational efficiency.
md.p2: As the Managing Director of Aban Pharmaceuticals, he plays a pivotal role in shaping the company’s vision and strengthening its presence in the pharmaceutical sector. He focuses on implementing robust quality systems, ensuring GMP compliance, and fostering a culture of excellence. Under his leadership, Aban Pharmaceuticals continues to deliver reliable, high-quality pharmaceutical solutions while building long-term trust and sustainable growth.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Aban Pharmaceuticals, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your information.
privacy.info_body: We do not collect any personal information directly through this website, as there are no forms or user input features.
privacy.usage_body: We may collect basic non-personal information such as browser type, device information, and pages visited for analytics and website improvement purposes.
privacy.cookies_body: Our website may use cookies to enhance user experience and analyze website traffic. You can disable cookies through your browser settings if you prefer.
privacy.third_body: We may use third-party tools (such as analytics services) that collect and process non-personal usage data.
privacy.security_body: We take reasonable measures to protect the website and ensure a secure browsing experience.
privacy.changes_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page.
privacy.contact_body: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, you may contact us through available communication channels on our Contact Page.
